articles.headline: Russian Cargo Ship Stays Aflame Off Coast of Finland
articles.brief: A Russian cargo ship remains on fire in international waters off the coast of Finland following an undisclosed attack. Emergency crews are monitoring the situation closely as environmental and safety assessments continue.

articles.headline: Deadly Adulterated Alcohol Outbreak Kills 11 in Manipur
articles.brief: At least 11 people have died and several others fell severely ill after consuming spurious, adulterated alcohol in India's northeastern state of Manipur. Local authorities have launched a sweeping investigation into illicit bootlegging rings operating in the region.

articles.headline: India's Wheat Planting Sees Historic Drop as Farmers Switch
articles.brief: India's wheat cultivation area is tracking toward its steepest decline in 26 years as farmers increasingly pivot to alternative, more lucrative crops. The shift could impact long-term domestic supply dynamics and agricultural export policies.

articles.headline: Climate Talks Advance After Intense Overtime Rifts on Finance
articles.brief: Negotiators at the annual United Nations climate summit pushed forward a compromise text after grueling overtime sessions characterized by deep divisions over fossil fuel phase-outs and green transition financing.

articles.headline: Beijing Set to Bar Young Red-Chip Firms From Foreign Listings
articles.brief: Chinese regulators are reportedly preparing new rules to block young red-chip companies from pursuing initial public offerings outside mainland China, aiming to keep domestic capital and technology firms close to home.

articles.headline: Ex-Google Engineer Warns AI Poses Severe Extinction Risk
articles.brief: Nate Soares, president of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute and a former Google engineer, warned that rapid advancements in artificial intelligence could present existential threats to humanity within the decade if safety protocols fail.

articles.headline: India's Congress Warns of Escalating Protests Against Meta
articles.brief: India's opposition Congress party has criticized local authorities and warned of continued demonstrations against Meta following recent violent clashes between police forces and protesters outside corporate offices.

articles.headline: German Union IG Metall Extends Walkouts Across Shipyards
articles.brief: Industrial action in Germany intensified as the IG Metall union expanded strike mandates to cover major automotive and shipyard manufacturing facilities amid stalled wage negotiations and persistent inflation pressures.

articles.headline: Maruti Suzuki Hikes Car Prices Due to Cost Pressures
articles.brief: Automotive giant Maruti Suzuki announced a fresh round of price increases across select models, citing sustained increases in input costs and supply chain constraints affecting manufacturing margins.

articles.headline: Anthropic Runs Unusual IPO Process, Chafing Wall Street
articles.brief: AI firm Anthropic structured an unconventional public offering process reminiscent of SpaceX, sparking friction among traditional investment bankers who sought more conventional underwriting controls and allocation terms.

articles.headline: Severe Winter Storm Threatens US Thanksgiving Travel Plans
articles.brief: Over 80 million American travelers face major holiday disruptions as a potent weather system carrying heavy rain, high winds, and potential tropical storm conditions targets Florida, New York, and East Coast transit hubs.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi Launches Scathing Attack on BJP and RSS
articles.brief: Senior opposition leader Rahul Gandhi issued sharp criticisms against the ruling BJP and RSS ideology, accusing leadership of fostering deep socio-economic inequalities and exclusionary cultural policies across India.

articles.headline: Jasprit Bumrah Matches Historic 2007 Test Bowling Feat
articles.brief: Indian fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah matched a notable record last achieved by Zaheer Khan in 2007 by dismissing New Zealand's Tom Latham for ducks in both innings during a dominant Test match performance.

articles.headline: Harshit Rana Sparked Confrontation in India A-Pakistan Match
articles.brief: Pacer Harshit Rana delivered an aggressive spell for India A against Pakistan A, keying an intense contest characterized by fiery bowling exchanges and crucial breakthrough dismissals during the tournament.

articles.headline: Kerala Teen Suffers Kidney Complications From Face Cream
articles.brief: A teenager in Kerala experienced severe kidney complications after applying an unregulated cosmetic face cream recommended through social media platform video tutorials, prompting fresh public health warnings.
